recalled.text: Company-specific: over fiscal_year 2023, 2024 Target (TGT) grew -1.57% and -0.79% YoY while its SIC 5331 peers grew faster: WMT 6.03% and 5.07%; COST 6.76% and 5.02%; DG 2.24% and 4.96% [ev-1].

Not sector-wide: Target (TGT)'s SIC 5331 peers excluding TGT grew 6.05% (fiscal_year 2023), 5.05% (fiscal_year 2024) in aggregate, versus TGT's -1.57% (fiscal_year 2023), -0.79% (fiscal_year 2024), a gap of 5.84 percentage points in fiscal_year 2024 [ev-2].
Target (TGT) revenue went from $109.12B (FY ending 2023-01-28) to $106.57B (FY ending 2025-02-01), a -2.3% change; YoY growth was -1.57% (FY ending 2024-02-03), -0.79% (FY ending 2025-02-01) [ev-1].
Not macro: US real private consumption grew 2.57% in 2023, 2.95% in 2024 while CPI inflation was 4.12% in 2023, 2.95% in 2024, so consumer demand was still expanding in real terms [ev-3].

Margin trade-off: Target (TGT)'s operating margin rose from 3.53% (FY ending 2023-01-28) to 5.22% (FY ending 2025-02-01) while its revenue growth lagged, consistent with prioritising profitability over sales [ev-4].

hypotheses.statement: Company-specific: Ford Motor's revenue growth fell short of its SIC 3711 peers over the latest four fiscal years in the data — refuted if Ford Motor's mean YoY growth is within 2 pp of the SIC 3711 peer median

Sector-wide: the SIC 3711 industry (peers excluding Ford Motor) grew about as slowly as Ford Motor over the latest four fiscal years in the data — refuted if the peer aggregate grew more than 2 pp a year faster than Ford Motor on average

Macro: weak real consumer demand (inflation eroding real spending) explains the growth pattern over the latest four fiscal years in the data — refuted if US real private consumption grew at least 1% a year on average
Margin trade-off: Ford Motor gave up revenue growth to rebuild operating margin over the latest four fiscal years in the data — refuted if Ford Motor's operating margin fell by 0.5 pp or more

evidence.purpose: YoY revenue growth of F and SIC 3711 peers over the window

result.sql: WITH rev AS ( SELECT ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, value_usd AS revenue_usd, LAG(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_revenue_usd, LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_fiscal_year FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND (ticker = 'F' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('3711'))) ) SELECT CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN 'focus' ELSE 'sic_peer' END AS role, ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_usd - prev_revenue_usd) / prev_revenue_usd, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM rev WHERE prev_fiscal_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F') - 3 AND (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F') ORDER BY role, ticker, fiscal_year LIMIT 200

evidence.purpose: Aggregate YoY revenue growth of SIC 3711 peers excluding F (same companies both years) vs F

result.sql: WITH rev AS ( SELECT ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, value_usd AS revenue_usd, LAG(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_revenue_usd, LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_fiscal_year FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND (ticker = 'F' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('3711'))) ), y AS (SELECT * FROM rev WHERE prev_fiscal_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND fiscal_year > (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F') - 3 AND fiscal_year <= (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F')) SELECT fiscal_year, MAX(CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN period_end END) AS focus_period_end, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN revenue_usd END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN prev_revenue_usd END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN prev_revenue_usd END), 2) AS focus_yoy_growth_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN 1 END) AS peer_companies, SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN revenue_usd END) AS peer_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN prev_revenue_usd END) AS peer_prev_revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN revenue_usd END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN prev_revenue_usd END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'F' THEN prev_revenue_usd END), 2) AS peer_yoy_growth_pct FROM y GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year LIMIT 200

result.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ticker = 'F' THEN 'focus' ELSE 'sic_peer' END AS role, ticker, fiscal_year, MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN period_end END) AS period_end, MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'gross_profit' THEN value_usd END), MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END) - MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN value_usd END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END), 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'operating_income' THEN value_usd END) / MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END), 2) AS operating_margin_pct FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE (ticker = 'F' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('3711'))) AND concept IN ('revenue', 'gross_profit', 'cost_of_revenue', 'operating_income') AND fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F') - 3 AND (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND ticker = 'F') GROUP BY ticker, fiscal_year ORDER BY role, ticker, fiscal_year LIMIT 200
